rationale: Operator decision 2026-10-12 after the decision rubric. Problem: 676 made staged-review leaves satisfy code+test coverage and reviewerSet:three on trust-chain diffs, with AI_SDLC_REVIEWER_SET env outranking committed config, citing DEC-0094 which is in the same PR (not authority). Weakening of a trust-chain control, class (b); RFC-0052 OQ-2 defers staged authority until 50 PRs at 95 percent precision, none measured. Research: in-toto/SLSA layouts, Sigstore policy-controller and GitHub branch protection all require the verifier's acceptance policy to come from a source the verified party cannot influence; relaxations ship after measured precision. Options: A drop-verifier (no weakening, lands today, staged advisory until OQ-2); B scope-verifier gated on base-ref review-config only, DEC-0094 on main first (right shape, premature: a weakening with zero data, ~1 day blocked); C land-dec-first as written with env precedence (rejected: verified party selects its own policy). Counter-argument to A: without credit the precision evidence never accrues. Rebuttal: OQ-2's measure is staged findings against the three-reviewer verdict, which advisory mode produces by running both; credit first would make it circular. Selected A over B (cost buys nothing until OQ-2 closes) and over C (env-selected policy). Follow-up: re-file DEC-0094 with B's base-ref gating once the OQ-2 evidence exists.
